meta.title: Cancellation, Return and Refund Policy
meta.subtitle: At Asian Spices Online B.V., we want you to be satisfied with your order. On this page, you can read how cancellations, returns, and refunds work.

support.heading: Questions about returns?
support.text: Feel free to contact us via email or phone for support with returns and cancellations.

blocks.text: 1.1 Before shipment

As long as your order has not been dispatched yet (no tracking number has been generated), you can cancel it completely free of charge. You will receive a 100% refund, including any shipping fees, and no cancellation charges will apply.
1.2 After shipment

Once a tracking number has been generated for your order, the order is in transit for delivery and can no longer be cancelled. From that moment on, any change proceeds via the Return Procedure (see section 3) once you have received the order.
1.3 Partial cancellation
Would you like to cancel only part of your order (and not the entire order)? This is possible before shipment under the following conditions:

items: A transport contribution fee will be charged for partial cancellation.

The remaining order value must remain at least €10.00 (our minimum order value). If the cancellation causes the remaining value to fall below this amount, only the full order can be cancelled, not partially.

sections.title: 2. Our Return Policy per Product Category

blocks.text: Because Asian Spices sells both perishable and non-perishable goods, different rules apply per product category according to Dutch and European consumer law (Article 6:230p of the Dutch Civil Code, as detailed on Consumentenbond.nl).
2.1 Fresh and frozen products (such as fresh fruit)

Fresh and frozen products are legally excluded from the right of withdrawal. This is not a choice of Asian Spices, but a fixed statutory exception under the law (Art. 6:230p BW): because these products deteriorate quickly in quality, you cannot simply return them without cause.

If the product arrives damaged, spoiled, or different from what was ordered, you as a customer are entitled to a resolution (replacement or refund). This falls not under withdrawal, but under your legal right to a sound product. Please report this to our customer service within 1 day of receipt; due to the perishable nature of these products, later reports may no longer be processed.
2.2 Packaged spices, herbs, and other foodstuffs

Statutory right of withdrawal (unopened packaging): packaged, shelf-stable foodstuffs fall under the statutory right of withdrawal of at least 14 days, as long as the seal on the packaging is unbroken. This statutory minimum cannot be shortened by Asian Spices.
Opened packaging: once the seal is broken, the right of withdrawal expires completely. This is a legally permitted exception (Art. 6:230p BW) for reasons of hygiene and food safety.

Complaint notification: independent of the formal right of withdrawal, Asian Spices applies a practical reporting window of 3 days after delivery for complaints regarding food products (e.g., quality, damage, or an incorrect item). This window is intended for swift service on food items and is separate from, and does not limit, your statutory right to withdraw an unopened, sealed package within 14 days free of charge.
2.3 Other, non-food-related items (“retail items”)

For non-food products in our catalog (such as kitchen accessories or other non-perishable non-food items), Asian Spices offers an extended return period of 30 days after delivery, more generous than the statutory 14 days.

blocks.text: Please note - legal clarification: The statutory cooling-off period of 14 days for unopened, sealed products is a mandatory minimum that a seller may not shorten. The 3-day window above is therefore intended as a customer-friendly, swift complaint procedure for foodstuffs, not as a replacement for the statutory right of withdrawal. Asian Spices does not sell custom-made or personalized products; this legal exception therefore does not apply to our catalog.

items: Status required: a return can only be requested once the order has the status “Shipped” or “Delivered”.
Submit request: submit your return request through your customer account on the online platform. State your order number, the product concerned, and the reason.
Assessment by Asian Spices: within 24 hours of your request, we will inform you whether we (a) need additional information, (b) accept the return, or (c) reject the return.
Opened packaging will be rejected, except when the product is defective, damaged, or incorrectly delivered (see section 2.2).
Packaging requirements: return the product complete and in the same condition as received (including original packaging and any accessories).

blocks.text: Return Address:
The costs of a return depend on the reason:
Error by Asian Spices (e.g., defective, damaged, or incorrect product):

items: Asian Spices bears the return shipping costs.
You receive a full refund, including original shipping costs.

blocks.text: Return at customer request (e.g., changed mind, unwanted):

items: The customer bears the return shipping costs.
A return handling fee of €3.95 per return applies.
Original outbound transport costs will not be refunded.

blocks.text: Payout:
The refund is processed within 7 days after approval of the return, to the original payment method (PAY. or PayPal), unless explicitly agreed otherwise.

Have you received a damaged, incorrect, or defective product? Please initiate a return or cancellation request via your customer account as described in section 3. Asian Spices will evaluate the report within 24 hours and will cover all costs in that case (see section 4).
Questions about a cancellation, return, or refund? Get in touch via:

Unable to resolve the issue with us? You can submit a complaint to the Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) or use the European ODR (Online Dispute Resolution) platform — a free EU platform for resolving disputes regarding online purchases: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
